scenes.setting: Back into Sharon's bedroom with deliberate footsteps: Dunn is clean-faced, wrapping the mirror — as if the blood on his lips had been an illusion
scenes.text_anchor: Klein held his breath with his back against the wall

scenes.setting: The nearest police station: a heavy-faced inspector Moretti reports a serious murder at 15 Osna Street
scenes.text_anchor: With Dunn's help, Klein quickly cleaned up the scene

scenes.setting: The dark rental carriage: spiraling doubts about the Captain — blood, mistakes, Kenley's death — settled by a plan to write to Daly
scenes.text_anchor: Having settled this, Klein headed back to Zouteland Street on a rental carriage.

scenes.setting: Blackthorn recreation room: telling Frye that Kenley is dead — 'You don't need to blame yourself... We must always trust our partners'
scenes.text_anchor: Taking a deep breath, Klein went to the recreation room

scenes.setting: Near dawn at the mortuary: the bodies brought back; Dunn quietly sends Klein home
scenes.text_anchor: It was nearing dawn by the time they got Kenley's corpse

scenes.setting: Sealed bedroom: a crumpled first draft, then careful letters to Daly and Azik about the blood on the Captain's mouth
scenes.text_anchor: Just as he had done the previous time, he easily entered his bedroom

scenes.setting: The copper whistle again: the bone messenger takes the letter to Azik and rains away
scenes.text_anchor: After folding the letter, Klein took out the copper whistle

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog: the pendulum confirms Dunn's abnormality WILL endanger Klein — but the divination on its cause returns only fog
scenes.text_anchor: Klein felt much calmer after finishing everything

scenes.setting: Morning at Blackthorn: a hollow-eyed Dunn relays the 4000-pound compensation for Kenley's family; shift change with Royale in silence
scenes.text_anchor: The next morning, Klein was on duty at Chanis Gate

scenes.setting: Chanis Gate duty: four black dots on his hand — members are praying, and must wait
scenes.text_anchor: He sat in the duty room and occasionally took out his silver pocket watch

scenes.setting: Home next morning: theater tickets go on sale today; the siblings head to Mass while Klein eats and retreats upstairs
scenes.text_anchor: Having just fished his keys to open the door to his house

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog (visions only: Justice praying from her bath, Alger's parallel request): both ask leave — the next Gathering is canceled
scenes.text_anchor: After he did the preparatory work, he took four steps counterclockwise

scenes.setting: City of Silver training field: the cancellation reaches Derrick under the eyes of the increasingly strange Shepherd elder, Lloydia
scenes.text_anchor: City of Silver.

scenes.setting: Shaken awake by a giant white-bone hand: Azik's reply lands on the bed
scenes.text_anchor: Klein returned to his bedroom, threw himself into bed

scenes.setting: Azik's reply: Vampires, Mutants, and pathway interchanges — the Sleepless pathway pairs with Death AND Giant; Dunn may be a potential Mutant
scenes.text_anchor: Klein opened the letter, feeling both expectant and nervous

scenes.setting: A dream summons: Dunn assigns him to help Leonard at 62 Howes Street — a Lanevus lead
scenes.text_anchor: In the hazy world, Klein was suddenly jolted to his senses.

scenes.setting: Quick wash and change; Bella told not to prepare lunch
scenes.text_anchor: Howes Street... Isn't that the area where the Divination Club

scenes.setting: 62 Howes Street: Lanevus's rented house — divination finds the bookshelf compartment, and inside, a taunting letter: 'prepare yourselves, I'm going to issue you a hint!'
scenes.text_anchor: He then took a public carriage to Howes Street

scenes.setting: 62 Howes Street: the rest of the letter — a 'bomb' in Tingen growing on factory workers' resentment, signed 'Lanevus, who enjoys giving his friends pleasant surprises'
scenes.text_anchor: Klein and Leonard lifted their gaze from the letter

scenes.setting: Blackthorn reception: the Maynard widow pays out 230 pounds, satisfied — the papers already carry Sharon's sanitized story
scenes.text_anchor: Just as they entered the Blackthorn Security Company's door

scenes.setting: Dunn's office: the letter read — a telegram goes to the Holy Cathedral for a mysticism expert to trace the resentment-fed altar
scenes.text_anchor: How was it? Did you find any clues?

scenes.setting: The day's paper: Sharon 'died resisting arrest', a heroic unnamed officer fell, and the mayor resigns over public security
scenes.text_anchor: Seizing the moment when Captain was sending a telegram

scenes.setting: The visitor: a seven-months-pregnant Megose wanders in 'somehow or other' — and Klein's spirituality screams DON'T LOOK: the bomb is the baby in her womb
scenes.text_anchor: He folded the newspaper quietly and returned it to the reception desk.

scenes.setting: The reception, on a knife's edge: 'my child told me — he knows a lot'; Leonard keeps Megose talking while Klein slips away
scenes.text_anchor: Klein instinctively reached for his pockets.

scenes.setting: Dunn's office: the bomb is Megose's unborn child — telegrams fly, Saint Selena's ashes authorized, and Klein flags that the coincidences have turned brazen
scenes.text_anchor: He saw Dunn looking shocked before turning serious

scenes.setting: Evacuating the clerks: Mrs. Orianna's blessing, and Rozanne's parting whisper about respecting Nighthawks
scenes.text_anchor: Klein didn't waste any more time.

scenes.setting: Warm water served to the increasingly restless Megose; a whispered 'keep her here' to Leonard
scenes.text_anchor: After seeing the clerks evacuate the Blackthorn Security Company

scenes.setting: The blue-lit corridor: Dunn ascends with the bone-silver box of Saint Selena's ashes and sends Klein for the strongest Sealed Artifact
scenes.text_anchor: Klein returned to the Captain's office, only to realize that Dunn had already gone underground.

scenes.setting: The intersection: trusting the Flaring Sun Charm over a Grade 2 artifact, Klein whistles up the bone messenger with an urgent note to Azik — the mastermind has surfaced
scenes.text_anchor: When he was nearing the intersection, Klein suddenly stopped.

scenes.setting: The basement corridor: weighing the three Grade 2 artifacts — Inexhaustible Poison, Door of Death — and choosing 2-105, the Blood Vessel Thief, for Leonard
scenes.text_anchor: In the corridor within the deep and serene basement

scenes.setting: Chanis Gate: Seeka Tron fetches the blood-tainted vessel through a crack in the gate, blessing them all
scenes.text_anchor: My dear Poet, it's time for you to show your true secret

scenes.setting: The reception hall: mid-chat, Megose absently rips out a handful of her own hair and tosses it in the trash
scenes.text_anchor: In the reception hall of the Blackthorn Security Company.

scenes.setting: Second floor with the ash box between them: the Holy Cathedral says stall — and Dunn casually mentions Daly told him to explain himself to Klein
scenes.text_anchor: Klein walked up the stairs to the second floor

scenes.setting: The corridor confession: the Law of Beyonder Characteristics Indestructibility — Dunn consumes his fallen partners' remains so Adelaide, Dwayne, Hitte and Kenley can keep fighting beside him in his dreams
scenes.text_anchor: Dunn sighed.

scenes.setting: The reception sofa: Megose claws bloody strips from her own face, smiling too wide — 'my child is a little restless'
scenes.text_anchor: On the sofa in the receptionist area

scenes.setting: Three minutes to descent: Leonard takes the Blood Vessel Thief, and Dunn walks out first with Saint Selena's ashes — 'We're guarding Tingen City'
scenes.text_anchor: After entering the corridor, Leonard stared deeply at the box of ash

scenes.setting: The battle for Tingen: Saint Selena's night-in-a-box binds Megose, the Flaring Sun Charm becomes a miniature sun, the bone-blade monster guts Klein and smashes Leonard — then, in the darkness, a baby's cry
scenes.text_anchor: Beep! Beep! Beep! The telegram set up in the Captain's office

scenes.setting: Light: Dunn tears out his own heart to feed Saint Selena's ashes, the last Flaring Sun Charm calls down a pillar of sun — 'We saved Tingen' — then a pale, bloody palm punches through Klein's chest
scenes.text_anchor: The baby in Megose's stomach cried.

scenes.setting: The cemetery-silent ruin: Leonard wakes to two bodies with matching chest wounds, pounding the floor in grief as reinforcements finally arrive
scenes.text_anchor: Burned and shattered objects were scattered around

scenes.setting: The red-chimney house at last: Ince Zangwill leafs through his story-writing notebook — every 'coincidence' of Tingen scripted, Klein's survivals scribbled out in frustration — until the final line: 'Tingen's story ends here'
scenes.text_anchor: In a Tingen suburb, there was a house with a green lawn.

scenes.setting: The guardroom after: the found telegram — 'Beware of Ince Zangwill. Beware of Sealed Artifact 0-08' — and Leonard vows to join the Red Gloves for revenge
scenes.text_anchor: In the basement of Saint Selena Cathedral, in the guardroom outside Chanis Gate.

scenes.setting: The doorbell at 2 Daffodil Street: Leonard tells Melissa her brother died a hero — the three 'Return of the Count' tickets fall to the floor
scenes.text_anchor: At 2 Daffodil Street, Melissa sat on the sofa

scenes.setting: The Moretti living room: 6000 pounds of compensation no one hears; Benson runs the tap in the bathroom until his red eyes can't be hidden
scenes.text_anchor: Sitting in the Moretti family's living room

scenes.setting: Raphael Cemetery: Klein's funeral after Dunn's — Melissa buries the copper whistle with him; the epitaph reads best brother, best brother, best colleague; alone at last, she weeps 'Stupid!'
scenes.text_anchor: A few days later, in a corner of the Raphael Cemetery.

scenes.setting: Night at the grave: Azik lays white flowers — 'I was ten minutes late. But I think I know who it was' — and leaves the copper whistle buried
scenes.text_anchor: Night time, at the Raphael Cemetery.

scenes.setting: The stone slab shifts — a pale hand rises from the soil: Klein sits up in his coffin, his missing heart slowly squirming back together
scenes.text_anchor: Suddenly, the stone slab sealing the grave was flipped open.

scenes.setting: The moonlit cemetery: Klein tidies his own grave, retrieves the copper whistle Melissa buried, and finds Dunn's tombstone — 'Captain... We miss you too!'
scenes.text_anchor: In the northern part of the Loen Kingdom, the September breeze

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog (visions only: the one-eyed statue-faced killer; a bridged, smoky city): the murderer is Ince Zangwill with Sealed Artifact 0-08, plotting from Backlund
scenes.text_anchor: He became silent again and found a hidden spot nearby.

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog (visions only: Backlund again for Lanevus; the Hornacis peak palace with its vertical pupil of symbols): both enemies and Klein's opportunities point to Backlund
scenes.text_anchor: So Ince Zangwill has gone to Backlund

scenes.setting: Out of the cemetery like a wandering ghost: past Dunn's grave, past the house he can't knock on, to sleep rough under his jacket
scenes.text_anchor: When he returned to the material world, he slowly walked out of his hiding spot

scenes.setting: Woken by a constable's baton — the Poor Law doesn't allow vagrants on the streets; the dead hero walks until daybreak
scenes.text_anchor: It wasn't long into his sleep when he was suddenly woken by someone.

scenes.setting: Backlund Bank withdrawal by password, a full new wardrobe, and a second-class ticket on the two o'clock train to Backlund
scenes.text_anchor: Soon after, he lowered his head and entered the Tingen branch of the Backlund Bank.

scenes.setting: The waiting area's emptiness pulls him back to Daffodil Street one last time, hiding in the shade across from the door he can't cross to
scenes.text_anchor: Klein suddenly had an empty feeling in his heart

scenes.setting: The circus in the municipal square: trailing his grieving siblings — then a pastel-faced clown conjures a golden Seville Chrysanthemum, the flower of happiness, and offers it with a wide, ridiculous smile. (End of Volume 1)
scenes.text_anchor: Suddenly, he saw the door to the house open as Melissa and Benson came out.
